description: This module is a wrapper for the execution of django-admin dumpdata.

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: Dump all records, including those which might otherwise be filtered or modified by a custom manager. Choices: false true

parameters.name: apps_models
parameters.description: Dump only the applications and models listed in the dump. Format must be either app_label or app_label.ModelName. If not passed, all applications and models are to be dumped.

parameters.name: database
parameters.description: Specify the database to be used. Default: "default"

parameters.name: excludes
parameters.description: Applications or models to be excluded. Format must be either app_label or app_label.ModelName.

parameters.name: fixture
parameters.description: Path to the output file. The fixture filename may end with .bz2, .gz, .lzma or .xz, in which case the corresponding compression format is used. This corresponds to the --output parameter for the django-admin dumpdata command.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Serialization format of the output data. Choices: "xml" "json" ← (default) "jsonl" "yaml"

parameters.name: indent
parameters.description: Indentation size for the output. Default is not to indent, so the output is generated in one single line.

parameters.name: natural_foreign
parameters.description: Use natural keys when serializing for foreign keys. Choices: false true

parameters.name: natural_primary
parameters.description: Omit primary keys when serializing. Choices: false true

parameters.name: primary_keys
parameters.description: List of primary keys to include in the dump. Only available when dumping one single model.

parameters.name: pythonpath
parameters.description: Adds the given filesystem path to the Python import search path. The value is passed as is to the --pythonpath argument in django-admin.

parameters.name: settings
parameters.description: Specifies the settings module to use. The value is passed as is to the --settings argument in django-admin.

parameters.name: skip_checks
parameters.description: Skips running system checks prior to running the command. Choices: false true

parameters.name: traceback
parameters.description: Provides a full stack trace in the output when a CommandError is raised. Choices: false true

parameters.name: venv
parameters.description: Use the Python interpreter from this virtual environment. Pass the path to the root of the virtualenv, not the bin/ directory nor the python executable.

parameters.name: verbosity
parameters.description: Specifies the amount of notification and debug information in the output of django-admin. Choices: 0 1 2 3

examples:
- name: Dump all data
  community.general.django_dumpdata:
    settings: myproject.settings
    fixture: /tmp/mydata.json

- name: Dump data excluding certain apps, into a compressed JSON file
  community.general.django_dumpdata:
    settings: myproject.settings
    database: myotherdb
    excludes:
      - auth
      - contenttypes
    fixture: /tmp/mydata.json.gz

return_values.name: run_info
return_values.description: Command-line execution information. Returned: success and verbosity >= 3

return_values.name: version
return_values.description: Version of Django. Returned: always Sample: "5.1.2"
